recipeStatus: 0.1.0-draft — channel recipes verbatim from the Phase 1 spec source-to-derivative map; pending Marketing Lead sign-off

recipes.label: LinkedIn posts (company + executive)
recipes.recipe: Feed-native posts. Company variants open with a feed-native hook and carry the campaign hashtag; executive variants are first-person POV, deliberately less corporate. Short paragraphs, no link dumps.

recipes.label: Email nurture snippets
recipes.recipe: Hook + CTA sized for one nurture touchpoint each. Subject-line-ready opening, one idea per touchpoint, a single clear CTA.

recipes.label: Sales battle card extract
recipes.recipe: Objection-ready summaries for ISR/Sales: objection, response grounded in a sourced claim, proof reference. Internal audience — direct and factual.

recipes.label: Executive one-pager
recipes.recipe: Condensed leave-behind: the value proposition, three proof-backed reasons to act, and the decision-stage CTA. Executive reading level, no filler.

recipes.label: FAQ / AEO extract
recipes.recipe: Direct Q&A formatted for AI-answer-engine extraction: each answer is self-contained, names LevelShift explicitly in answer-extractable text, and states the sourced fact plainly.

recipes.label: Community post draft
recipes.recipe: Authentic, non-promotional community voice: share the insight as a practitioner would, invite discussion, no CTA and no sales framing.

recipes.label: Call scripts
recipes.recipe: Conversational opener, two discovery questions tied to persona pains, one sourced proof point per script, and a soft next step. Internal audience.

recipes.label: Sales enablement notes / service-page brief
recipes.recipe: A discrete section brief for the existing service page plus enablement notes: what changed, which claims are approved for reuse, where each claim is sourced.
